Class XYPair

java.lang.Object
xbot.common.math.XYPair
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.wpilib.util.struct.StructSerializable, org.wpilib.util.WPISerializable
public class XYPair extends Object implements org.wpilib.util.struct.StructSerializable
Pair of X and Y coordinates. Can be used for points, vectors, or anything else that requires a coordinate pair.
